cohort: The study included 575,817 singleton live births in Sweden at 36 weeks gestation or later, excluding those not eligible for vaginal delivery, with preterm premature rupture of membranes, or congenital anomalies.
finding: No excess risk of neonatal respiratory distress was found for elective cesarean section (ECS) from 40 weeks and for induction of labor (IOL) from 38 weeks when compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: IOL was found to be safe from 38 weeks and ECS from 40 weeks regarding neonatal respiratory distress, with earlier gestational ages increasing risk for both modes of birth.
